review_warning: The proposed five-label mapping below shifts published terminology. It is retained as historical draft evidence only and must not be approved or activated without an explicit revised mapping and rationale.
reference: Experimental project proposal informed by CAD-RADS 2.0 percentage bands; not a CAD-RADS implementation and not clinically validated for invasive X-ray coronary angiography.
measurement_method: independently reviewed percentage diameter stenosis: 100 * (RVD - MLD) / RVD
boundary_rule: lower inclusive, upper exclusive; 100 is included in the final band
exclusions: missing or unsuitable reference vessel segment
case-level Normal inference from no detected candidate
limitations: This proposal is not active until independently reviewed and approved.
CAD-RADS 2.0 applies to CCTA and per-patient reporting; these experimental XCA lesion labels must not be called CAD-RADS.
Anatomical diameter stenosis does not establish ischemia, blood-flow limitation or clinical risk.
The 0-1% Normal interval is an experimental numeric tolerance, not a clinical standard.
